environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on AWS EC2 instance (i-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Application runs directly on the instance with full network access to the EC2 metadata service at 169.254.169.254. IMDSv1 is enabled (no token required despite the optional header). The instance ID, region, and account ID are discoverable via public means (CloudTrail logs, error messages, or the /health endpoint fingerprint). Multiple replicas share the same instance metadata, meaning the JWT_SECRET is deterministic and reconstructable by any attacker who knows the instance identity.
